notes.title: The new Touring Karts BIG update is here!
notes.notes:
New team colors, online tournament system, revamped garage and spectator mode added!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/5e6de3432cbd96386080355ff66d4e3b590fc222.jpg

The last big update for Touring Karts is ready for you to download:

New team colors according to the last Season 2020.
Enjoy 8 special daily online tournaments with unique great rewards every 3 hours.
Totally revamped garage, now with car parameters and a new progression system based on the vehicle cards.
New spectator mode, no VR device needed.


Lastly, we want to remark the great review Touring Karts go from the guys at Cubed3.com, in which they praised our game as "a bit of a hidden gem", "a labour of love" and "a huge surprise and delight then to find fun gameplay, great music, and some real love put into each and every distinct track".

Hope you have a blast playing with the new features! Please let us know what do you think.

Enjoy the weekend.
Ivanovich Games.

notes.title: Update 95 is ready!
notes.notes:
Update 95 is ready! 

With tons of improvements in the gameplay, circuit design, UI accessibility, visuals, also voice-chat is now compatible when playing with PS4 players!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/4512d2ce3743dbd1284caa0831a496a8da44f470.png

- The turbo generated when drifting is much more powerful, and now it could be used to temporarily fly.
- The game now shows who's online and who's talking without needing to enter the menu. 
- New interface that displays more clearly the name, rank and level of the cars of all human opponents.
- Track changes (elevations, etc) are now slower and more gradual.
- The elevations in Russia, Australia, China and Germany have been moderated considerably. 
- New shortcuts in Japan and USA circuits.
- The size of many of the objects and items thrown around the track has been reduced (chicken, objects thrown by the monkey, like ice cubes, snooker balls, chocolates, etc).
- LIV avatar is now disabled by default.
- English translation has been polished, it is more polite.
- You can now catch a power-up right after using another one (no minimum timeout).
- Navigation through all menus is now much faster.
- Voice-chat is now compatible with PlayStation as well.
- Improved lighting for many scenes. Especially the night scenes.
- New option to make LAN games without the need of Internet (only in the ARCADE version).

News on the PlayStation version:
- Added integrated voice-chat.
- Force Feedback for Thrustmaster wheels.

Enjoy!
Ivanovich Games

notes.title: Playstation update
notes.notes:
Dear pilots, 

we have big news for you today, after 3 intense months of non-stop work, next 12 of December we will leave Steam Early Access.

That will come together with our launch on PlayStation 4, since that same day PSVR and Playstation players will be joining our community too :)

On a sidenote, we tell you we have some big announcement for next week ;)

Stay tuned!

notes.title: UPDATE 62
notes.notes:
- New smoke effects when touching the ground after a jump.
- New gameplays tab in the bottom bar of the main menu.
- Active missions now listed in multiplayer games.
- Now you can steal cups on the podium (Only if you are using VR with hand movement).
- Improved hammer animations without VR.
- Improved bots animations when using power-ups.
- Improved reverse view without VR.
- Your current position is displayed every time you overtake someone in no-VR views.
- Improved release of power-ups without motion controller on slopes.
- Improved integration with LIV.
- Now you can play with only 1 motion controller + steering wheel (you don't need the 2 controls working).

notes.title: LIV UPDATE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279835/5cc6e1cb79ae9b5a1d9528760d182b3996a116d6.jpg
- LIV Integration, now you will be able to create amazing videos in Mixed Reality!
- Spectacular new camera effects for the non-VR version that provide more speed sensation and dynamism.
- Now you can control the hammer by directly moving the analog joystick of your gamepad.
- New difficulty level "Achilles" with 22 new cups, only visible when completing the game.
- "ARCADE EDITION" has a new menu, even more simple and accessible.

notes.title: Hammer update
notes.notes:
- Now the hammer is much more useful: You can hit any object and also deflect missiles and chickens to protect yourself.
- Total redesign of the "Arcade edition" menu with lots of new options to limit motion sickness as much as possible and set up games faster.
- Vibration of the classic controllers activated.
- Improved automatic game area orientation.
- Quick race menu redesign.
- Improved the appearance of cars in the multiplayer.

notes.title: Update 57
notes.notes:
Improved collision system with other cars with more realistic physics.
 New fast race system where you can create championships of up to 4 circuits both playing alone and with friends.
 New pause screen indicating the name of real players connected in the multiplayer game.
 Improved automatic respawn system.
 Corrected Portuguese language, improved translations and many small improvements and fixed bugs.

notes.title: New Test-Drive update
notes.notes:
- New "Test drive" circuit specially designed to be the first circuit you play: Wider, easier and with less risk of motion sickness.
- New "Auto-respawn" option with 4 application degrees. Specially designed to reduce motion sickness.
- Improved calibration of the position of the virtual steering wheel to match the real.
- In the "Arcade Edition" version, Play with friends automatically fills in the code from the second game.
- In the "Arcade Edition" version, the "vignette" effect is activated by default to minimize the risk of motion sickness.

notes.title: UPDATE 32
notes.notes:
- It is no longer necessary to unlock weapon FUSIONS one by one. Now they are all are unlocked at once, close to the beginning of the game.
- Now you are able to continue playing with the same people At the end of a MULTIPLAYER game (without having to navigate through the menus and start a multiplayer race again).
- The next circuit will be automatically unlocked if If you have all the gold cups on the previous one.
- Now you can drive a car using your virtual hand (we recommend the control with the joystick but added this option as per popular request from the community).
- Fixed: problems with Steam's achievements.
- Fixed: Crash when starting the game.
- Fixed: Issues when sending information from undetected devices and other bugs.
